g.text: Assembler: packets → blocks of 1024 spectra (6 packets per spectrum, 6144 slots per block)
At most 4 open blocks. The oldest is sealed when complete, or when the newest block is more than 2 ahead (stale):
its missing slots are zero-filled and counted. Blocks with no packet at all are 'skipped'. Duplicates and packets for sealed
blocks are rejected. t jumping back by more than 1024 blocks = stream restart (re-sync).
